description.value:
Requirement You have not Stridden this turn.

Duration until the start of your next turn

You fire in the pause after the exhale, the way you were taught by somebody who is no longer around to ask.

Steady the weapon. Until the start of your next turn, your firearm’s range increment increases by half, and you are not off-guard from having taken a reaction. Since your Draw already pays no penalty for distance, this does not make far shots easier — it makes far shots closer, and moves the whole distance-damage ladder out with it. You lose this if you Stride, are pushed, or take damage from an area effect.

cinderfall.incomplete: (homebrew distance-damage ladder, named explicitly in the card's own text) + no roll-option hook exists to auto-cancel the buff on the three stated interrupt conditions without a companion effect. This effect is defined entirely in terms of a Cinderfall-homebrew subsystem with zero Foundry schema footprint (the Gun Failure Table/Failure Range, hazardous ground, time-in-sights, Trick Iron charge bank, or Drift/augment-slot cost). Confirmed via the full rule-element type listing (pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/, 40 files): no RollTable-manipulation, no persistent-terrain-hazard, and no arbitrary stacking-counter rule element type exists to hook any of these to.
